summary: Helicopter landing zone FOSS activated at EGUN; non-participating aircraft may not use taxiways Delta North and Alpha.
text:
HELICOPTER LANDING ZONE FOSS ACTIVATED FOR ROTARY WING/TILT-ROTOR 
OPERATIONS. NON-PARTICIPATING ACFT MAY NOT UTILIZE TWY DELTA NORTH 
AND TAXIWAY ALPHA BTN TWY ALPHA WEST HAMMERHEAD AND AMC RAMP.
